stops.note: cymbals; in 1623 Avedis, an Armenian alchemist in Constantinople, began casting them and was given the name 'Zilciyan', cymbal-maker
the family firm, as Zildjian, moved to Massachusetts in 1929; 'zills' became the English name for dancers' finger cymbals

current_meaning: small finger cymbals played in pairs, especially by belly dancers
